# Kinstel Solutions

> Kinstel Solutions is a premium web design, custom software development, and digital growth agency headquartered in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, serving clients across India and globally (USA, UK, Canada, Australia).

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Custom Next.js & React Web Engineering**: High-performance, hand-coded static & dynamic web applications. Engineered for 90+ PageSpeed scores, zero plugin vulnerability, and sub-second load times.
- **Custom Web Platforms & SaaS MVPs**: Full-stack application design, custom dashboard interfaces, API integration, and cloud-native software architecture.
- **Conversion-Focused Web Design**: Bespoke UI/UX design tailored for professional services, luxury brands, technology startups, and corporate platforms.
- **SEO & Organic Growth Marketing**: Technical SEO, structured data implementation, local search optimization, content strategy, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).
- **Google Ads & Performance Marketing**: Pay-Per-Click campaign strategy, landing page conversion rate optimization (CRO), lead generation, and ROI tracking.
